notes.title: Menu self-voicing and demo achievement fix
notes.notes:
A minor patch, fixing an issure where self-voicing in the main menus did not work.

The missing final achievement in the demo should now also activate properly.

notes.title: Achievements fix!
notes.notes:
Hello!

It turns out that achievements were unfortunately broken in the new version of Blue Rose. This issue should now be solved, and achievements once more triggering correctly.

Apologies for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Blue Rose Reprise released!
notes.notes:
Blue Rose is back in an updated, polished version as Blue Rose Reprise!

Reworked to run in a newer version of Ren'py and at a higher resolution of 1080p, this update is free for anyone who already owns the original.

Other updates to the game include:
- Many polished sprites and event illustrations
- Revisions to the script, fixing errors and improving it overall
- New UI
- New opening video

Whether you have visited the world of Blue Rose before, or are entirely new to the game, I hope you will all enjoy this revised version and join Lena in her adventures!
